messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> service: inference-runtime-eu-west-az6 | severity: P1 | symptom: sustained KV cache evictions + ~10-15% 5xxs on generation endpoints. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-eviction

pagerduty-bot: Incident  ID RD-20260315-az6 created by monitor. Escalation: primary oncall -> L2 -> L3 if unacked for 5m. PD link: https://pdd.redwood/incident/RD-az6

Lia (SRE): acked. I’m oncall — grabbing logs and checking last deploys. @Ops-Oncall please coordinate traffic diversion if needed.

Alex G (infra): ack. seeing repeated OOMs in kvcache-worker on az6 nodes03-07. stack traces show `alloc failed` around the same time as increased cold starts. pulling `dmesg` and docker logs.

Samira (runtime): adding context: we rolled out kernel bump and memtune last night in az6. Might be interaction with kvcache reclaimer under many small seqs. Running preflight rehydration check now.

Kevin (ml-infra): logs: `kvcache: shard=4 rehydrate failed: checksum mismatch` x 3 on node05. Also seeing per-shard latency spikes to 400ms. Suspect partial corruption or race on rehydrate.

Ops-Oncall: I’m preparing fallback routing. Recommend divert 20% read-only generation traffic off az6 to eu-west-az7 and enable cache-bypass for affected model variants. If we do 20% first we can validate. Command to update routing (prod-run):
```
# divert 20% to eu-west-az7
infractl route update --service inference-runtime --region eu-west --from az6 --to az7 --weight 0.2 --dry-run=false
# enable cache-bypass for model: rw-gg-13b-v1
infractl feature-flag set kvcache_bypass rw-gg-13b-v1 --env prod
```

Marta (support): customers to flag: prod-tenant-17, analytics-inc, and edu-labs. Marta -> I’ll page CS for top customers and prepare a status note.

Jordan (CS): got prod-tenant-17 on call, they are seeing ~30% failure rate on `/v1/generate` with 500s. They want ETA. I told them we’re investigating and will update in 15.

metric-bot: metric snapshot -> inference-runtime-eu-west-az6: cpu 94% (avg 5m), mem 88%, 5xx-rate 12% (5m), kvcache-evictions/sec 120. az7 metrics nominal.

Lia (SRE): proceeding with phased diversion. Alex, coordinate with Samira to keep stateful rehydrate tasks paused for now. Kevin, can you start rehydrate job in read-only mode against a restored snapshot? We need to avoid writing corrupt shards.

Kevin (ml-infra): starting read-only rehydrate on shard 0-3 to verify checksums. Command: `rehydrate-tool --shards 0-3 --mode readonly --src s3://kvcache-backups/eu-west/2026-03-15/` ETA ~12m.

Alex G (infra): applied routing change: `route update` returned 200. Verified `weight` in control-plane: az6 80% -> az7 20%. Watching for error rate delta.

Samira (runtime): toggled kvcache_bypass for rw-gg-13b-v1. This causes slightly higher token compute but reduces backend cache pressure. Observing p95 latency.

metric-bot: new snapshot (5m after divert): az6 5xx-rate -> 7% (down from 12%), az7 5xx-rate -> 2%, overall p95 latency up 6% across diverted traffic.

Ops-Oncall: PD note: L2 team paged for potential shard corruption and node remediation. @Kevin and @Alex coordinate on node05 replacement if rehydrate fails.

Kevin (ml-infra): read-only rehydrate results: shard checksums inconsistent on node05. Starting targeted restore from S3 to node05 with `rehydrate-tool --shards 4 --mode restore --target node05`. Will block writes to shard until done.

Lia (SRE): activating prefailover plan: if any node fails full restore or more than 2 shards hit corruption, we will increase diversion to 60% and spin up extra capacity in az7. Notify partners.

Marta (support): status page draft: "We are experiencing increased errors from inference runtime in eu-west-az6. We have diverted a portion of traffic to eu-west-az7 and are performing shard restores. Some customers may experience elevated latency and intermittent 5xx. Investigating." Will post after Lia approves.

Jordan (CS): pushing an interim note to prod-tenant-17: informing them of traffic diversion and estimated mitigation within 45 minutes. They acknowledged.

Alex G (infra): node05 restore finished. KV checksums now match on restored shard. Re-enabling writes to shard in 30s.

metric-bot: after restore: az6 5xx-rate -> 4.5%, kvcache-evictions/sec -> 30. CPU 72%.

Samira (runtime): Gradual rollup plan: keep kvcache_bypass enabled for 30m, monitor errors. If stable for 20m, revert routing back to 95% az6.

Ops-Oncall: PD escalation: L3 oncall notified due to checksum corruption. L3 (Kevin) acknowledged and is owning root cause.

Lia (SRE): marking incident mitigated -> applying mitigation window. I’ll keep incident open for postmortem and RCA. Marta, please post status page now and include impacted customers.

Marta (support): Posted status: https://status.redwood/status/incidents/1788888888. Sent email to SRE/CX lists.

Jordan (CS): closure update to tenant-17 done. They appreciate the quick response.

Lia (SRE): closing PD after final monitoring window. Final notes: root cause suspected: kvcache rehydrate race under kernel/memtune change + partial snapshot mismatch. Action items: 1) revert memtune bump in az6 (Samira/Alex), 2) add checksum validation in rehydrate flow (Kevin), 3) run cross-az canary for kernel changes (Lia). Postmortem owner: Lia. ETA for 1st draft: 72h.

Ops-Oncall: incident cleared from pager. Adding follow-up ticket to backlog: INF-4872 (kvcache rehydrate hardening).

incident-bot: PD incident RD-20260315-az6 -> status: mitigated -> closed by Lia (SRE) at ts 1788892500.

Marta (support): filed customer-impact summary to the internal triage doc and notified account leads.

Lia (SRE): thanks team. small retro in 24h. :thumbsup:
